name: streakly
tagline: A habit-vlogging app: Express, PostgreSQL, JWT, Docker Compose.
summary: A TikTok-inspired habit tracker where each check-in is a short video. Node and Express on PostgreSQL with a hand-written schema and seed, access and refresh JWTs, bcrypt, multer uploads, a vanilla-JavaScript client, and a Docker Compose file that brings the whole stack up with one command. The one classic full-stack CRUD-and-auth project on this page.

swe.angle: Access and refresh tokens, bcrypt, uploads, and a Compose file that stands the stack up in one command.

data.angle: A hand-written PostgreSQL schema and seed, rather than an ORM's guess at one.

highlights: Access plus refresh JWT flow with bcrypt-hashed credentials.
schema.sql and seed.sql checked in, so the database is reviewable in a diff.
